prompts.title: Write a handoff
prompts.text: Mail arrived at 08:02 and the queue was empty at 08:05. Write two lines for the next shift. Label anything the timestamps cannot prove as unknown.

prompts.title: Read back a count
prompts.text: I will say two pretend counts aloud. Repeat the numbers as digits before you explain the change. If a number is unclear, ask me to repeat it.

prompts.title: Tighten a notice
prompts.text: The practice room opens at 10 and closes at 2. Write a sign in twelve words or fewer. Keep both times exactly as supplied.

sections.title: Research and check a source
paragraphs: Pick an example, copy it and change the fictional inputs. Open its chapter for the limits and a result to check.
sources: Use chat in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help

prompts.title: Compare revisions
prompts.text: Use only the two selected notes. Which rule changed between revisions A and B? Cite the old sentence and the new one. If either is missing, say which one.

prompts.title: Find the rule
prompts.text: Use the uploaded practice handbook. Quote the line about closed tickets, name its revision and tell me whether a draft ticket counts.

prompts.title: Check a feature
prompts.text: Find the current official help page for scheduled tasks. Give the page title, one supported surface and a link. Mark any limit you cannot confirm as unknown.

sections.title: Spreadsheets and mail
paragraphs: Pick an example, copy it and change the fictional inputs. Open its chapter for the limits and a result to check.
sources: Attach & analyze files in Gemini Apps - Computer - Gemini Apps Help
Frequently asked questions about Copilot in Excel

prompts.title: Count blanks
prompts.text: Here are the counts in order: 0, 2, blank, 3. Report the total, the number of filled cells and the number of missing cells. Show the row that contains a real zero.

prompts.title: Check a formula
prompts.text: In the practice workbook compare the displayed total with the four visible rows. List each cell used. Leave the workbook unchanged until I review the difference.

prompts.title: Test one explanation
prompts.text: One fictional mailbox rejected a 14 MB message. A second received the same message. List two reasons. For each, name evidence that would weaken it. Give one read-only test and no change command.

sections.title: Build and test a file
paragraphs: Pick an example, copy it and change the fictional inputs. Open its chapter for the limits and a result to check.
sources: When to Use Devin - Devin Docs
Using Codex with your ChatGPT plan

prompts.title: Review a patch
prompts.text: In the practice counter, rename Clear to Reset. Show the changed lines. Test two increments and a reset. Report expected and actual scores.

prompts.title: Make a preview
prompts.text: Build a two-button tally in Canvas. Start at zero. Add increments once per click. Reset restores zero. Show the number after each click in Add, Add, Reset.

prompts.title: Fix a small bug
prompts.text: Use the practice repository. A saved score of zero shows as missing. Reproduce it using a local sample. Fix the display and show test results for zero, blank and five.

prompts.title: Make an offline file
prompts.text: Create a single HTML packing list with two checkboxes and a count. Use no remote files. Tell me how to test checking, unchecking and opening it offline.

sections.title: Schedule and delegate
paragraphs: Pick an example, copy it and change the fictional inputs. Open its chapter for the limits and a result to check.
sources: Schedule recurring tasks in Claude Cowork
Manage your tasks & workflows in Gemini Apps - Computer - Gemini Apps Help

prompts.title: Check a repeat job
prompts.text: Using fictional notes only, prepare a weekly summary every Friday at 10 in the time zone I confirm. Show the next occurrence. Report an empty note as missing input.

prompts.title: Check a reminder
prompts.text: Set a reminder to review a pretend supply list each Monday at noon. Confirm the time zone and next run. Show how I can pause it.

prompts.title: Plan a scheduled check
prompts.text: Define a scheduled read-only test run for a practice repository. List the branch, expected test output and the condition for asking a human to review it. Do not schedule it yet.
